description: A perspective view of a wide flight of stairs with a handrail at each side and a dashed handrail down the middle, dividing the flight in two (see para 1.15). A dimension across the top of the whole flight reads 'If more than 2m wide the flight should be divided'. A dimension across one of the two halves at the bottom reads 'Divisions of flights should not be more than 2m wide, measured between the inside edges of handrails'.
model_description: This diagram, titled "Diagram 1.5 Dividing flights", depicts a three-dimensional perspective drawing of a flight of stairs. The drawing shows a set of stairs with handrails on both sides. A dashed vertical line extends from the top of the stairs down through the steps, indicating a division in the flight. An arrowed dimension line at the top of the stairs indicates the width of the flight, accompanied by the text: "If more than 2m wide the flight should be divided". Below the stairs, a text label states: "Divisions of flights should not be more than 2m wide, measured between the inside edges of handrails". In the top left corner, there is a reference that reads: "See para 1.15".
